additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0422073-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / N9 160352270 ] cable was cut off CRM:02684000190
additional_info.body:
Hi Eduard Huber,
Thank you for the picture.
We are transferring the case to the RC queue for further action.
Upon review, the charger shows both outlets as healthy. However, we have observed successful charging sessions only on Outlet 2, while Outlet 1 has not recorded any sessions since May 2nd. This indicates that the cable on Outlet 1 has likely not yet been replaced.
For safety reasons, we strongly advise against powering off the charger. To mitigate any potential risks, we are disabling Outlet 1 until further action can be taken. There is a risk of a short circuit, which could lead to a significant current surge, potentially causing further damage to the charger and posing a safety hazard.
Thank you for your understanding.
Best Regards,
Sominath Nagalgaon
eMobility Support Team
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.

additional_info.subject: RE: AW: ID0422073-DC/Si-D/DE-[ MP / N9 160352270 ] cable was cut off CRM:02684000190
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-DE Team,
The end customer reported the issue by stating that the “cable was cut off.” Upon reviewing the provided photos, it was confirmed that the cable on the DC1 outlet is indeed cut.
Further inspection via SCB shows that all outlets are outlets as healthy. However, for safety reasons, we have disabled the DC1 outlet through SCB to prevent any risk of short circuit or further damage.
Please communicate with the customer and proceed with the necessary actions.
The part number for the DC1 cable is for a 400A, 5-meter length. As the cable has been cut, it is not repairable and must be replaced.
